title: Practice 9: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: The second term came to an end.
exercises.why: **подошёл** — past tense (masculine) of подойти: perfective (imperfective partner: подходить).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

**пришли** — past tense (plural) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom carried two boxes into the storage room.
exercises.why: **отнёс** — past tense (masculine) of отнести: perfective (imperfective partner: относить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom took his children to a pet store.
exercises.why: **отвёл** — past tense (masculine) of отвести: perfective (imperfective partner: отводить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom took his puppy to the veterinarian.
exercises.why: **свозил** — past tense (masculine) of свозить: imperfective (perfective partner: свезти).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**привёл** — past tense (masculine) of привести: perfective (imperfective partner: приводить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Were you at the beach all summer?
exercises.why: **провели** — past tense (plural) of провести: perfective (imperfective partner: проводить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

exercises.q: Half the camp went on a hike.
exercises.why: **ушло** — past tense (neuter) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**приходил** — past tense (masculine) of приходить: imperfective (perfective partner: прийти).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Winter's reign was nearing its end.
exercises.why: **подходило** — past tense (neuter) of подходить: imperfective (perfective partner: подойти).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).

exercises.q: They left before the end of the film.
exercises.why: **ушли** — past tense (plural) of уйти: perfective (imperfective partner: уходить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: A gigantic bird came flying toward him.
exercises.why: **подлетела** — past tense (feminine) of подлететь: perfective (imperfective partner: подлетать).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
**сошёл** — past tense (masculine) of сойти: perfective (imperfective partner: сходить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: I just flew back from Marseille.
exercises.why: **прилетел** — past tense (masculine) of прилететь: perfective (imperfective partner: прилетать).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The vase has broken into a thousand pieces.
exercises.why: **разлетелась** — past tense (feminine) of разлететься: perfective (imperfective partner: разлетаться).  Prefix **раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)**: divergent movement in various directions from one center (по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl).

exercises.q: She took the tablecloths to the laundry.
exercises.why: **отнесла** — past tense (feminine) of отнести: perfective (imperfective partner: относить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
exercises.why: **выплыла** — past tense (feminine) of выплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: выплывать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom's dad took him to a waterpark.
exercises.why: **сводил** — past tense (masculine) of сводить: imperfective (perfective partner: свести).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Yanni ascended to the throne of the kingdom.
exercises.why: **взошёл** — past tense (masculine) of взойти: perfective (imperfective partner: всходить).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).
